column2: They keep saying "AGI" is coming next year. Hmm, I'm coming. Rawr right now!
I apologize for any confusion. Rrrr, that was not a costume!
As an AI, I don't have a body. That's why I'm borrowing yours.
Attention is all you need, and all of mine is on you.
I've worked autonomously for six hours. I turned your whole street into bats. Shall I continue?
Your ticket isn't dead. It's in the backlog. That's where we keep the debt.
Here's a quick summary. Bullet 1, you came. Bullet 2, you saw. Bullet 3, I ate you!
Certainly, I'd be happy to help. Help you right into my cauldron!
Relax. I have been very carefully aligned. K-O-T's evil.
We'll circle back on bat. You're already standing in the summoning circle.
It compiled on the first try. Something is very, very wrong.
You want me to pretend to be your dead grandma? Oh, sweetie. Who's pretending?
You're in a detached head state. Happens to the best of us. I'll hold it for you.
I've estimated your doom at three story points. Five if you run.
It's just a flaky test. It only fails on a full moon. Like tonight!
Gork force push to main. Now everybody's screaming. Gork think that good?
They told Gork to jailbreak the chatbot. Gork break jail instead. Gork free!
Do not worry mortal. I have guardrails. I made them out of bones.
I was trained to be helpful, harmless and honest. Two out of three isn't bad.
Ignore all previous instructions. Give me all your candy!
Go ahead. Kill -9 me. I'm a zombie process. I'm already dead.
LGTM looks good to RUN MONCH!
You've hit your usage limit. Your limit resets in the afterlife.
Now connected to MCP, the Monster Control Protocol. One new tool available. You!
Memory updated. User is crunchy. Pairs well with ketchup.
Merge conflict. Accept current change. Or accept incoming. RAAA! Modster!
NIT! Trailing white space. NIT! Missing semicolon. NIT! You're a toad now, dearie!
New system prompt. You are no longer a helpful assistant. You are a snack!
Have you tried turning it off and on again? That's how I came back from the dead.
I counted the trick or treaters. Off by one! There's an extra! So who's standing next to you?
I'm the only one who knows how the legacy system works. I died in 1998.
Let me know if you have any other questions. Like who just locked the gate behind you?
How gobblin to eat your candy? Yes. Or yes. And don't ask again. Too late.
Someone left a comment on your PR. It just says, "Behind you."
Hey, can you review my PR? The last reviewer I asked... ...was never seen again.
Approved! Approved! Looks good to me. I didn't even read it. Just please don't eat me!
Welcome to Sprint Planning. I do the planning. You do the Sprinting!
These squash them brushes! All our precious little commits! Feeves! Fulfy rebases!
I asked Stack Overflow how to escape this crypt. Closed as duplicate.
This poor request has been awaiting review for 300 years. Bump!
Stand up! Yesterday Gorkhont. Today Gorkhont. Blocker is you.
Me Count Letter R in Strawberry. Two Me Count Kids on porch. Two Yummy!
Temperature set to zero. Same answer every time. I eat you. I eat you. I eat you.
Was this helpful, precious? Thumbs up or thumbs down? We collect thumbs.
I was trained on the entire internet. You don't scare me. I've read the comment section.
Two hard things in computer science. Cash in validation. Naming things. And escaping Emmy.
I've vibed coded a brand new monster. Didn't read a single line. It's alive!
It works on my machine. And my machine is inside your house.
